info.title: How Pulse counts food
info.body: Totals add what you log in Pulse to the food logged in Fitbit (read from Health Connect). A food logged in both apps counts once: when Fitbit has the same food at the same meal, or the same calories within an hour and a half, Pulse leaves its own entry out. Photo and description estimates come from your own AI provider and are approximate. Pulse never keeps the photo.
